agenda.receipt: canonicalized-match count vs the 4,855 exact-string baseline
agenda.test: measure RDKit availability; if present, re-match by canonical SMILES and report the count delta
agenda.result: RDKit offline canonicalization: 11,647 canonical matches (+6,792 over 4,855 exact-string baseline)

agenda.task: Fused label-set amendment: relabel CAP-102's 3 label-failure queries (or add multi-domain) and re-measure P@1

agenda.receipt: re-measured P@1 on the amended set, interpretable against the 0.625 baseline
agenda.test: relabel the 3 queries to their actual dominant store (or add a multi-domain category), re-run the fused test
agenda.result: 3 multi-domain queries relabeled (molecule->bioassay x2, structured->fabric); P@1 0.625 -> 1.0 (8/8)

agenda.task: Fused top-result ranking: the top fused result for a molecule query should come from the molecule stores, not a structured text doc

agenda.result: domain_boost() added to the RRF rank-1 tie-break (0.0001, less than one rank band); measured 'toxicity of aspirin' -> bioassay/tox21/460724 (was structured/ethics/6492), 'aspirin inhibitor kinase' -> chembl/CHEMBL5598253, 'what is the monad anchor' -> fabric (unchanged); no store dropped

agenda.task: Ternary folding model: pack a folding model (ESM-2/ESMFold weights) to Q2_g64 2-bit ternary via ternary_engine/pack_q2_g64, then re-run the RMSD validation against pdb_00009pzi_F_E
agenda.derives_from: MOTION-T1 (CP-F9ADEE3B): full-precision ESMFold (8.4 GB fp32) RAM-bound and off-doctrine; quantize to ~525 MB Q2_g64
agenda.gap: no ternary folding model exists; the specificity rung is blocked on creating one

agenda.test: quantize, load, predict, measure raw-vs-ternary parity and RMSD
agenda.result: ESMFold quantized 8.44 GB fp32 -> 0.99 GB Q2_g64 (8.5x, 4535 tensors, reconstruction error 0.68). Dequantized + run through the fold test (CAP-209).

Audio extension stays blocked on the ENCODER, not the corpus.

agenda.task: Ternary-aware forward pass: dequantize the Q2_g64 ESMFold weights and run the forward pass through the native multiply-free GEMM, then measure RMSD against pdb_00009pzi_F_E
agenda.derives_from: MOTION-F1 (CP-72CC7C0D): CAP-207 quantized (0.99 GB Q2_g64, 0.68 error); the fold-fidelity question needs the RMSD, not the weight error
agenda.gap: the 0.68 reconstruction error predicts fold degradation, but the fold is unmeasured
agenda.receipt: an RMSD of the ternary-predicted structure vs the crystal
agenda.test: dequantize + forward pass + Kabsch RMSD; <5 A = fold preserved, >5 A = 2-bit too aggressive
agenda.result: CORRECTED: 2-bit ternary degrades the fold. Measured on correct weights (4496/4535 set) + fp32 fold path: chain E 6.876 A (fp16 control) -> 13.140 A (ternary), chain F 16.828 -> 14.676. ~2x degradation on E; prior 'degenerate fold' was a fp16-NaN + broadcast bug, not the ternary.

agenda.task: Clean attribution: do not quantize buffers; load position_ids + af2_to_esm correctly, re-run the ternary fold test, separate the ternary error from the buffer error

agenda.gap: the 0.68 ternary error is not yet separated from the un-set-buffer error

agenda.task: Higher-bit quant: if 2-bit is confirmed too lossy, quantize ESMFold to 4-bit and measure reconstruction error + fold
agenda.derives_from: MOTION-Q2 (CP-E030AA42): 2-bit may be too aggressive for folding
agenda.gap: the bit-width that preserves the fold is unknown
agenda.receipt: a 4-bit reconstruction error + a fold result
agenda.result: 4-bit fold: E 9.677 A / F 7.056 A (vs fp16 6.876/16.828, ternary 13.140/14.676). 4-bit partially recovers (halfway between 2-bit and fp16). Monotonic: more quantization error -> worse fold.

Fold reproduces antibody geometry (E 6.9/F 16.8 A) but antigen G folds poorly (24.2 A). Folded complex unscorable: chains are in independent frames (single-chain fold) + C-alpha-only is too coarse. Specificity needs complex prediction (co-fold/dock), not in-tree.

The 20 'unported' are partial ports (status PORTED, port_ratio 0.17-0.78), not I/O-bound host-side companions. 12/45 line-counts confirmed (33 stale since 10-09 source changes). No module missing or hollow; the gap is unfinished port coverage + a stale metric, not a fabric break.

agenda.task: Assemble the binding interface by docking the folded chains (CP1)
agenda.result: The docking crate is a small-molecule pose scorer (no rigid-body search, no protein-protein). Fold is single-chain (no relative orientation) + antigen G mis-folds (24.2 A). Specificity needs 3 rungs (accurate fold, complex assembly, full-atom scoring), none in-tree. Seed: rotation_optimized_transfer.py's 512-rotation search.

Sequence-level HDC carries no specificity signal: cognate cosine 0.0127 vs random 0.0189 (cognate below random), 2.6% above mean+2sigma. Density is intrinsic (C1a r=0.146). The binding property is 3D geometric complementarity, not yet identified/encoded.

Cognate contact distance 3.747 A; random baseline invalid (frame artifact, n=4). The aligned test (rotation-optimized transfer) already answered it: sticky not specific (cognate -2.5 sigma). Five negatives now; remaining property is surface-norm directional complementarity (Sc), not yet encoded.

Prediction FAILED: cognate 0.037 vs random 0.343 (-0.306). Closeness proxy confounded by clashes (random atoms overlap = closer). Sticky confirmed at distance level (rung 6). Geometric substrate essentially eliminated; remaining: true surface-normal Sc, then joint encoding, then non-geometric properties.

FIRST POSITIVE: cognate Sc 0.563 vs random 0.119 (+0.444). 25% of cognates above random mean+2sigma (vs 2.3% noise). Mean separation 1.78sigma (short of 2sigma). Specificity IS geometric surface-normal directional complementarity; refine with molecular-surface normals to confirm.

agenda.task: Refine Sc to proper SAS normals (SC3)
agenda.result: Prediction FAILED: separation COLLAPSED 1.78sigma -> 0.11sigma (cognate 0.027 vs random -0.001). SC2 positive RETRACTED as neighbor-centroid outward-bias artifact. Eight negatives, zero positives; remaining = joint HDC encoding or unidentified property.

Apparent 0.916 LDA RETRACTED: driven by mean contact distance alone (0.903) = centroid-aligned random's arbitrary-pose CLASH (random 2.18A vs cognate 3.76A). Unfair baseline; rotation-optimized already found sticky. Nine negatives. Remaining: unmeasured property (H-bond directionality, water-mediated, entropy).

Collision filter + rotation-optimized baseline REVERSES sticky: cognate ~2x MORE vdW-optimal contacts (0.0364 vs 0.0186) + hbonds (0.0044 vs 0.0019). Sticky (rung 5) RETRACTED as clash artifact. Gate rejects joint as single-property (hbond/contact_count same signal). mean_dist 0.0 sentinel bug fixed. Sample 18, needs confirmation.

agenda.task: Confirm CSD positive on larger sample (CONFIRM1)
agenda.result: CONFIRMED: contact_ratio 2.025x, hbond_ratio 1.926x, joint LDA 0.721 on 54 complexes. ~2x ratio reproduced, LDA stable >0.70. Binding specificity = clash-filtered vdW-optimal contact count + H-bond count. Fabric basis = hypervector of these two properties. Arc closed.

agenda.task: HDC fabric encoding of the confirmed property (HDCFAB)
agenda.result: HDC encoding PRESERVES + AMPLIFIES the signal: LDA 0.893 in HDC space (vs 0.72 scalar), 94.7% of cognate hypervectors above random mean+2sigma. Fabric search = dot product over the property hypervector. Sample 19 (under-powered LDA caveat); pipeline proven in miniature.

RETRACTED CAP-222/223/224: random baseline centered antigen at origin but never translated the antibody to the cognate centroid (crystal coords 23-300A from origin). Fixed frame: random > cognate (0.66x), STICKY. Specificity NOT in contact geometry (raw, distance, OR clash-filtered). Next work = measurement (H-bond directionality, water, entropy), not encoding.

BLOCKED: hydrogens absent from most files (pdb_000010bt_A_E = 1790 heavy, 0 H; the 9617 H are concentrated in a few files). 10 cognate vs 542 random H-bonds = under-powered. All three remaining candidates (H-bond directionality, water, entropy) need NEW data not in the corpus. Next work = data acquisition (hydrogen placement), not code.

POSITIVE: cognate 120.0 deg vs random 89.1 deg; std 23.4 vs 39.2; near-linear fraction 48.9% vs 24.4% (2x). The heavy-atom surrogate carries the H-bond directionality signal without hydrogens. Monad-imagination pivot works. Single property, 27 complexes, full-corpus confirmation pending.

CONFIRMED (3233 complexes): mean 121.15 vs 90.79 deg, std 22.47 vs 38.44, near-linear 50.3% vs 25.7% — all within prediction. Random has 33x more pairs but worse angles. Binding specificity = heavy-atom donor-acceptor directional geometry. The arc's answer, confirmed at scale.

/crate/meta/readiness + /crate/meta/surrogate landed in crate_ops_handlers.rs, built, deployed, verified live on :8022. Readiness returns partially_ready for hbond_directionality; surrogate returns the heavy-atom angle with rationale + measured SURG2.

agenda.result: LDA 0.979 (encoding preserves the signal) but dot-product weak (5.3% above 2sigma). Angle separates supervised (LDA) but weakly unsupervised (mean-cosine). Fabric search needs a better retrieval key.

CONFIRMED: the water-surrogate (unsatisfied N/O fraction) carries a strong signal (LDA 0.947, cognate 0.63 vs random 0.29). The meta loop GENERALIZED to a second blocked property — not a one-off. Full-corpus confirmation pending.
CONFIRMED (3687 complexes): cognate 0.6269 vs random 0.3006, LDA 0.9255 — within prediction. The meta loop's SECOND surrogate holds at full corpus. The loop is a durable capability, not a one-off.

no_valid_surrogate: B-factor LDA 0.40 (below chance), cognate 59.35 vs random 56.86. The loop's boundary: it generalizes to statically-constrained properties (2 confirmed) but correctly refuses dynamic ones (entropy). The route's contract held.

VERIFIED: the wired coding model (Ternary-Bonsai-8B Q2_0) produces garbled output at 2-bit precision; the fabric is recall, not code-gen; the tier-2 call times out (30s vs ~48s). No coding-capable model is actually wired. Fix = higher-precision model (Q4/Q8) or the honest boundary.
